description: Query and back up Alibaba Cloud WAF 3.0 billing data. Use this Skill when a user asks to check WAF bills, export WAF cost details, back up WAF billing data locally, or analyze daily/hourly SeCU and Credit usage. The Skill retrieves instance information, daily bill summaries, and hourly cost breakdowns (function fees, traffic processing fees, Credit usage) via aliyun-cli, then exports the results as JSON and CSV files to the local workspace.
